messages:
maya: FYI starting v2 rollout tomorrow at 17:00 PT. This rollout flips the default response format and enables strict-response-fields. Need a clear rollback + pin plan.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: api-gateway/v2-toggle -> canary stage in 30m. CI: all checks passed. :rocket:

jordan: What percentage for canary? 5% ok? Also are we using a header gate or implicit default? If we default to v2 for missing header that could break older SDKs.

maya: 5% initial. For canary we'll let header be optional to observe behavior, but prod will require X-API-Version once we're confident. Plan: canary w/ header optional, monitor errors and client parsing. Rollback threshold: >1% spike in 4xx/5xx.

li: Heads-up: mobile SDKs currently don't set X-API-Version. Product asked for smoother migration. Suggest we keep a v1-compatible serialization fallback for 14 days and emit an deprecation header so SDKs can pick it up.

gabe: +1 on compat window. We should also log User-Agent and client-id to identify who needs nudging. Propose response header: X-Deprecation-Warning with doc link.

product-sam: I'll prepare release notes and a short migration guide for SDKs. Also will notify top 20 customers and post to status page. Need a one-liner for the customer note.

emily: I'll wire up a temporary dashboard: parse-errors, 4xx rate, sdk-exceptions, and latency tail. Alerts: tenant error rate >0.5% sustained over 5m -> page oncall.

maya: Rollback playbook (brief): 1) deploy-bot revert tag api-gateway@v1-pin -> promote 2) flip routing flag to route-default=v1 3) set require-header=false 4) post to #incidents & notify customers. Target revert within 15m of decision. Any gaps?

jordan: Sounds good. Can v1 pool handle a surge if we pin? @li

li: v1 pool has spare capacity for current canary + initial 25% rollout. I'll pre-warm 2x extra workers 10m before canary start. Also will add a temporary autoscale override for 30m.

deploy-bot: Rollout started: canary 5% -> enabled. Monitoring links: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/v2-rollout

maya: Posting migration snippet for release notes: 
```
curl https://api.redwood.ai/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-API-Version: 2" -d '{"prompt":"Hello"}'
```

maya: If we see unexpected 4xx uptick, we'll pin and revert within 15m. Otherwise plan is +25% at +30m, +50% at +90m if stable.

product-sam: I'll send the customer note and update changelog now. Also adding deprecation banner to dashboard. :ok_hand:
